capabilities: Change heading levels via gutter markers
intentEvidence: A simple plugin that makes working with headings in Obsidian faster and more visual.
motivation: A simple plugin that makes working with headings in Obsidian faster and more visual.
problem: Users often struggle to visually identify heading levels or efficiently change heading levels within a document.
summary: A plugin that displays visual heading indicators in the editor gutter and allows users to quickly cycle or set heading levels using clicks or keyboard commands.
